components.description: Paid short-term disability leave for a faculty member giving birth, for the period the physician certifies (typically 6 weeks after a vaginal birth, 8 after a Caesarean), paid at full salary under the Sick Leave Plan and Short-Term Disability (Policy 339) schedule for faculty, which includes the New York statutory disability component.
components.mechanism_note: V1/V1b: the handbook states a childbirth-specific leave (VI.C) with its typical length (6 weeks natural birth, 8 weeks Caesarean); the pay level comes from the governing plan, Policy 339 (faculty: months of full salary by service; 2 to 4 years of service: 4 months full salary, then 2 months half). The plan covers any disability up to 6 months in a 52-week look-back; the childbirth period is recorded here rather than the plan maximum.

notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. Every document is in force on that date: Faculty Handbook May 2017; Policy 339 effective January 2018; Policy 358 updated 3/16; Policy 357 revised 1/2016; Policy 267 created 12/17 (PFL effective 2018-01-01); PFL summaries dated Dec 2017; the faculty FAQ (2018_00_link) is undated, Wayback copy 2018-04-14 (academic year 2017-18).

Governing documents for faculty leave are saved (Faculty Handbook VI.C, J, K, L and IV.A.3, IV.E; Policies 339, 358, 357, 267), so missing is false. The handbook says that in a conflict the University's personnel policies govern.

Source precedence: the FAQ's Q.2 'Option 2' (a semester at half salary in lieu of the 6-8 paid weeks) appears in no governing document; the May 2017 handbook has no such option, though the FAQ says 'See details in the Faculty Handbook'. Recorded as c17, summary_only. The FAQ's 'Option 1' (full salary for the first eight weeks of the STD period) matches the Policy 339 faculty schedule and is used only as a detail of c1 (V1b). The FAQ also describes medical/clinical faculty (16-week equivalent of modified duties or half-salary leave) - noted in c5 and c17.

U8: a faculty member with two years of service is in Policy 339's '2 but less than 4 years' band: 4 months full salary then 2 months half salary (6 months in a 52-week look-back). Under 2 years: 2 months full, 4 half; 4+ years: 6 months full. The childbirth period (6/8 weeks) is at full salary in every band.

Birth parent chain: short-term disability childbirth leave c1 (6, up to 8 weeks; NY DBL c2 alongside from the eighth day; 2-week paid parental leave c4 concurrent with c1, paid once) -> NY PFL leave c14 with its benefit c13 (8 weeks, consecutive after STD) ; FMLA c3 (12 weeks) alongside from the start; all within the discretionary semester-of-birth modified duties c5 (R3b). FAQ-only Option 2 c17 is in lieu of c1.

Non-birth parent chain: 2-week paid parental leave c4 (primary caregiver only) within the discretionary modified-duties semester c5; FMLA c3 alongside it from the start; NY PFL c14/c13 (8 weeks) with no placing link for this role (runs concurrently with FMLA, runs_concurrently_with).

Combined caps: Policy 267 limits disability and PFL to 26 weeks combined in a rolling 52-week period (flagged ambiguous: restriction on c1, c2, c13 per checklist §5 example 8; not a cap_weeks_all_sources). The FAQ says time off for the child may be taken under FML 'with total leave not to exceed 12 weeks' and vacation may not be used to take more than 12 weeks: this restates FMLA's 12-week entitlement and is not recorded as a leave_limits entry.

Not components: academic leaves, junior faculty leaves and bridging fellowships (scholarly purposes, handbook IV.E.4, 5, 8); leaves of one week or less / under a month (arrangements for absences, no leave entitlement); childcare referral, lactation rooms, EAP (not leave, pay or protection); staff sick pay and staff disability schedules (staff only). The handbook's personal leaves (IV.E.6, 'such matters as family illness or other urgent matters') are implemented by the two unpaid leaves of VI.L (c12, c16).
Calendar: the handbook and FAQ describe 'a traditional academic semester (approximately 16 weeks)'; recorded as calendar.term_weeks 16.

Documents cited but not saved: SMD Regulations of the Faculty (Appendix III-B); Long-Term Disability plan; Short-Term Disability plan documents; Provost's website (faculty STD information); Policies 102, 106, 109, 112, 113, 121, 134, 151, 158, 170, 171, 263, 271, 273, 336; Policy on Policy-Making; Leave Administration website 'Leave of Absence' section; PFL certificate of insurance; Time and Labor User's Guide; NIH Grants Policy Statement; IT, COI and research policies. Only those bearing on a component are flagged on it (c1, c11, c15, c18).
